filterSummary: Filtered out irrelevant videos (physics, system design fluff, Windows tips, etc.). Removed videos with wrong audio language (Hindi, Urdu, Tamil, Bangla, Telugu, Portuguese, Chinese). For Arabic, lacked good candidates for EAT and Write Policies topics, so only three Arabic videos selected.
